findings.description: getDiagnostics() returned empty default state after finishCleanup cleared this.active. Fixed by retaining lastDiagnosticSnapshot before clearing active session. Added owner-bound access control so non-owning callers get empty diagnostics.
tests_added: session.test.ts: diagnostics return empty for non-owning caller

findings.description: assembleUserContext() used ALL historical user transcript entries, potentially re-executing previous consequential requests on new delegations. Fixed by adding per-delegation inputCursor that advances after each delegation send settles. New delegations only see transcript entries added after the cursor.
tests_added: contract-verification.test.ts: fresh-input cursor prevents stale replay (4 tests)
tests_updated: delegation-regression.test.ts: updated 2 tests to reflect cursor-based input isolation

findings.description: sendCommentary/sendThinking are fire-and-forget void calls per the SDK. Chunked commentary preserves full text. Provider send errors are caught and non-fatal. End during in-flight send is properly fenced. The SDK CommentaryAppendedEvent acknowledgment correlation is NOT implemented — the SDK sends void, and the session correctly does not mark delivery on socket.send alone. This is a limitation of the current provider adapter, not a bug.
findings.remaining_gate: SDK acknowledgment correlation for CommentaryAppendedEvent is not implemented. Would require provider adapter extension to track client_event_id on sends and match against incoming acknowledgment events. NOT COMPLETE — labeled as future work.

findings.description: Unknown create before session ID blocks across restart. Persist-failure latch. Sync-close race (idempotent). Valid >300s actual usage retained. Corrupt ledger rejected. Sideband socket error triggers safe teardown. maxRetries:0 in provider constructor. All verified with existing + new tests.
findings.remaining_gate: Automatic orphan reconciliation is NOT implemented. Only lockout + manual confirmClosure resolves uncertain state. This is by design per the spec — uncertain closures remain locked until manually reconciled. No automatic paid POST retries confirmed.

findings.description: Added owner checks on /end and /diagnostics endpoints. Server /end handler now verifies ownerId matches session owner. /diagnostics passes ownerId for owner-bound access. Transcript bounded to 500 entries. getSessionOwnerId() exposed for server entry integration. No raw credential fields in diagnostics output.
